title: Negative Commodity Prices – Causes and Effects
主要内容: In April 2020, the NYMEX crude oil price fell below zero, marking a historic low. This occurred due to a supply glut and overflowing storage facilities, leading to negative commodity prices. Sellers paid buyers to take oil off their hands, highlighting the impact of supply-demand imbalances. The event also raised concerns about natural gas facing similar negative price scenarios due to limited storage capacity. The collapse in crude oil prices, with $7 identified as support, underscored the risks of unlimited downside in markets without storage or financing options.
